comment: Read from the repository at commit ce83bfe, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. Four slider outputs and the MIDI input are inherited from the shared base module and are never placed on this panel, so they cannot be clicked and get no line; the sliders are on the MiniLab. The expander's place in the chain is worked out at MiniPad.cpp line 20 by walking left until a MiniLab is found, counting MiniPads on the way, and that number is both the panel's index display and the controller pad it answers to. Pad presses reach the expander on MIDI channel 16, which the MiniLab reserves for the purpose, while everything else arrives on the channel the MiniLab is set to. Aftertouch is the one signal read outside the active check, at MiniPad.cpp line 133, so pressure on the pad is followed even as the pad is being released. Every jack is single channel, and the voltage ranges given are the ones the module starts with.
